_comment: Ramsgate events for 1.14.7 (DF-EVENTS-1147, Nov 9). The launcher's Events page writes the choice to data/city_events.txt.
Its on= list holds two kinds of names. Feature flags (city_event_*_bpff ...) go to the town as ?OverridenFeaturesOn= (tools/server-1147.ps1):
decorations, the event stall with event Ozz, Linnea. schedule:<ID> entries go to backend/events1147.js, which makes that event run now in the
seasonal event schedule; the game turns on every quest whose EventId matches. tested=false: in the game files and switched the same way, not yet
played through. Infinite has its own install and is not changed by this page.

events.title: Frostfall 2022: The Silver Sword
events.blurb: Snow and Frostfall decorations in Ramsgate, event Ozz with the five Frostfall quests, Linnea Silver with the Silver Sword quest chain (Slayer level 11 and a crafted Hypothermica), and Snowball Fight island events on Coldrunner Key and the Snowblind Waste.

events.title: Dark Harvest
events.blurb: Ramsgate dressed for Dark Harvest, the event stall, and the Dark Harvest quests and rumours.

events.title: Ramsgiving
events.blurb: The event stall and the Ramsgiving quests. The game files have no Ramsgiving decorations for Ramsgate.

events.title: Springtide
events.blurb: Ramsgate dressed for spring, the event stall, and the Springtide quests.

events.title: Saint's Bond
events.blurb: The festival of friendship and hearts: Ramsgate decorations, the event stall, and the Saint's Bond quests.
